like Joe Rogan recently retweeted my buddy Chris Ramsey who posted this photo that's now been verified at the highest levels of this sort of square structure on Mars that looks artificial

tellings.link_reason: Both are the square, artificial-looking structure on Mars in an image only recently brought to wide attention.

as_told.title: Square structure on Mars photo shared by Chris Ramsey

plain: Michels says that in 2001 the Mars Global Surveyor, a NASA spacecraft that photographed Mars from orbit, took a picture of a square structure on the surface that looks artificial, and that the picture has only recently reached a wide audience. On another episode he says his friend Chris Ramsay, who posts about UFOs online, shared the photo, the podcaster Joe Rogan reposted it, and it has since been "verified at the highest levels", though he does not say by whom. If true, it would point to something built on Mars.
